objective.name: sandbox.dsl.aggregate.params.matter.remote.query
objective.description: Aggregate final params from one wrapper output, one matter.read payload, and one remote meaning.query payload.

#root.role: Build one wrapper record, read one local matter, query the remote root meaning projection, and synthesize final wrapper params from all three sources.

effects.wrapper_param_source: One local wrapper output contributes to the final params.
effects.matter_param_source: One local matter.read payload contributes to the final params.
effects.remote_meaning_query_source: One remote meaning.query payload contributes to the final params.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one final wrapper input projection whose params are synthesized from one previous wrapper response, one matter.read response, and one remote meaning.query response.
invariants: The final wrapper call receives label from the root input, message from sandbox.build.record, source_ctx from the local matter payload, and selected_name/selected_ctx from the remote projected row.
The flow refreshes the remote projection before querying it so the selected remote row is derived from a rebuilt meaning index.
success: The terminal payload exposes received_params.label, received_params.message, received_params.source_ctx, received_params.selected_name, and received_params.selected_ctx.
received_params.selected_name and received_params.selected_ctx come from the first remote meaning.query row.
failure: The flow fails if the remote projection rebuild or the remote query fails after its retry policy is exhausted.
The flow fails if the local matter read or final wrapper call cannot be completed.
notes: This scenario validates that a DSL can aggregate local wrapper output, local matter content, and remote reflective projection into one terminal wrapper call.
The remote meaning.query is intentionally used as a projected selector, not as a detailed descriptor reader.

filters.value: Wrapper-backed echo capacity for N5 inter-instance tests
